title: Python gotcha: a mutable default argument shared between calls
issue: Each call without `lines` must start a new order. With `lines`, add_line appends to that same list and returns it.

decoys.why: copies the list on every call: new orders are separate, but the caller's list is no longer appended to

patches.new:
lines = list(lines)
    lines.append((sku, qty))
    return lines
